title: Tower projection formula for compactly supported direct image over the standing field
statement:
Work in the standing scheme setting of [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]: a prime $\ell$, a field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$ with $p\ne\ell$, separated finite-type $k$-schemes and $k$-morphisms; no further hypothesis on $k$. Fix a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], put $A_n=\mathcal O_E/\ell^n$, and on a scheme $T$ let $A_{n,T}=(A_n)_T$ be the constant sheaf of rings on $T_{\mathrm{proét}}$. Use the varying-coefficient tower category $\operatorname{Tow}(T,\mathcal O_E)$ of [sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers], its ordinary unbounded derived category with exact level evaluations $C_\bullet\mapsto C_n$ [det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian], and its full subcategory $\Dctf(T_{\mathrm{proét}},\mathcal O_E/\ell^\bullet)$ of towers whose levels lie in $\Dctf(T_{\mathrm{proét}},A_n)$ with cohomological and Tor intervals independent of $n$ [sk-def-sp-normalized-towers]. Derived tensor over the ring system $(A_{n,T})_n$, the termwise inverse images $u^{-1}$ along scheme maps (with the canonical identifications $u^{-1}A_{n,T}=A_{n,T'}$), derived direct images, termwise extension by zero along open immersions, and their adjunction units and counits are taken on the simultaneous section models of [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections].

Let $f:X\to Y$ be a $k$-morphism with a compactification $X\xrightarrow{j}\overline X\xrightarrow{p}Y$, $j$ an open immersion and $p$ proper [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], and let $F_f=Rp_{*,\bullet}j_{!,\bullet}$ be the tower compact-support functor of [det-sp-tower-shriek-levels]; $j^{-1}p^{-1}=f^{-1}$. Let $C_\bullet\in\Dctf(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\mathcal O_E/\ell^\bullet)$ and $B_\bullet\in\Dctf(Y_{\mathrm{proét}},\mathcal O_E/\ell^\bullet)$; normalization is not assumed. Then $C_\bullet\otimes^Lf^{-1}B_\bullet$ and $j_{!,\bullet}C_\bullet\otimes^Lp^{-1}B_\bullet$ lie in $D^+$ of the tower categories, and in $D(\operatorname{Tow}(Y,\mathcal O_E))$ the two morphisms
$$F_fC_\bullet\otimes^LB_\bullet\xrightarrow{\ \pi_p\ }Rp_{*,\bullet}\bigl(j_{!,\bullet}C_\bullet\otimes^Lp^{-1}B_\bullet\bigr)\xleftarrow{\ Rp_{*,\bullet}(\pi_j)\ }F_f\bigl(C_\bullet\otimes^Lf^{-1}B_\bullet\bigr)$$
are isomorphisms. Here $\pi_p$ is the proper projection map: the adjoint transpose, under $p^{-1}\dashv Rp_{*,\bullet}$, of the counit $p^{-1}Rp_{*,\bullet}j_{!,\bullet}C_\bullet\to j_{!,\bullet}C_\bullet$ tensored with $p^{-1}B_\bullet$, after the pullback/tensor comparison $p^{-1}(N\otimes^LB_\bullet)\simeq p^{-1}N\otimes^Lp^{-1}B_\bullet$. The map $\pi_j:j_{!,\bullet}(C_\bullet\otimes^Lj^{-1}p^{-1}B_\bullet)\to j_{!,\bullet}C_\bullet\otimes^Lp^{-1}B_\bullet$ is the open projection map: the transpose, under $j_{!,\bullet}\dashv j^{-1}$, of the unit $C_\bullet\to j^{-1}j_{!,\bullet}C_\bullet$ tensored with $j^{-1}p^{-1}B_\bullet$. Both are morphisms of derived towers, natural in $C_\bullet$ and $B_\bullet$, and their $n$-th evaluations are the corresponding finite projection maps for the constant ring $A_n$. Hence $F_fC_\bullet\otimes^LB_\bullet\simeq F_f(C_\bullet\otimes^Lf^{-1}B_\bullet)$ canonically and naturally.

proof.text: For the unconditional properMap_evaluation law, first use lem-sp-tower-geometry-adjunction-evaluation to evaluate the adjunction transpose. Naturality of tensorEvaluation moves the counit through evaluation. Substitute the normalized finite counit, expand levelPullTensor and finiteProperMap, and cancel the paired pushEvaluation and tensorEvaluation isomorphisms. This proves the proper finite projection evaluation before any boundedness or constructibility hypothesis. The other steps and their remaining holes retain the existing plan.

proof.text: For the unconditional openMap_evaluation law, use lem-sp-tower-open-adjunction-unit-evaluation. Apply the finite Hom equivalence to the evaluated open arrow. Operations.openTensor_mate identifies its tower transpose. Naturality of tensorEvaluation moves the unit through evaluation. Substitute the finite normalized unit and expand levelPullTensor and finiteOpenMap; tensor functoriality and inverse-pair cancellation give exactly the stated finite unit transpose. The remaining domain and invertibility steps stay unchanged.

It puts both asserted tensor inputs in $D^+$, constructs the two specified natural tower maps, and identifies their evaluations with the finite counit and unit transposes.

proof.text: Write $\ell=u_0\varpi_E^e$, so $A_n=A_{E,en}$ is finite and killed by $\ell^n$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Each $C_n,B_n$ is bounded constructible of finite Tor amplitude by [sk-def-sp-normalized-towers]. The compactification stays in the standing setting [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. Apply [lem-sp-finite-level-projection-factors] to $A_n,C_n,B_n$: its coefficient comparison makes the finite hypotheses agree, and its proper and open maps are isomorphisms. Step 1 identifies these with $(\pi_p)_n,(\pi_j)_n$; applying $Rp_*$ preserves the inverse of $(\pi_j)_n$, giving invertibility of every evaluation of $Rp_{*,\bullet}(\pi_j)$.

proof.text: Clause 3 of [det-sp-tower-shriek-levels] detects isomorphisms in the ordinary unbounded derived category of towers. Hence both actual tower maps are invertible. Compose $\pi_p$ with $Rp_{*,\bullet}(\pi_j)^{-1}$ to get the asserted isomorphism. Naturality of the maps from step 1 implies naturality of the inverse and composite. No normalization or compatible choice of finite flat representatives is used.
